topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I sift through the pages, the words stark against the white. They've captured my essence, the laughter, the quiet moments, the storms of my soul laid bare. Each line a footprint, leading back to a trail I didn't know was being traced. The room feels smaller, the air different. The sun, it's in the same spot, but everything casts a longer shadow. I set the manuscript down, fingers lingering on the last page, pondering the life that leaks onto paper. The world outside hums, indifferent, but inside, the gears turn, recalibrate. I find myself looking at the door, at the path leading back to where these words were woven.
